newsitem.title: USA: Oakley CFO Robert Bruning resigns.
newsitem.headline: Oakley CFO Robert Bruning resigns.

text.p: Oakley Inc said on Friday that its chief financial officer, Robert Bruning, resigned to rejoin a former colleague and pursue an opportunity in the golf industry.
Oakley's chief operating officer, Link Newcowb, a former chief financial officer, will assume Bruning's position on an interim basis while the company seeks a permanent replacement.
Bruning joined Oakley in January, after Cobra Golf was acquired by American Brands Inc. Now Bruning is rejoining a former Cobra Golf principal in a new venture, Oakley said.
Oakley last month reported first-quarter net income of $0.01 per share, compared to $0.15 per share for the same period the year before.
Oakley makes eyewear. Its shares closed at 10 on Thursday. The 52-week high was 27-1/8.
